note_en: The staff page BatchUpdateODH finds outstanding notices whose current offender is a given ID (not PS) and updates the offender data and address without changing the stage. It differs from Batch Furnish (41.50), which overwrites the offender and resets the stage; no story mentions this feature.

story: OCMS41.43, OCMS41.44, OCMS41.45, OCMS41.46, OCMS41.47, OCMS41.48, OCMS41.50, OCMS41.51 (komentar controller)
type: Kode tanpa story di chunk ini
note: Komentar menyebut OCMS 41.41-41.51, tetapi tidak ada pemanggil di ocmsadminui/ocmseserviceui dan path /v1/furnish/officer/manual tidak ada di api-authorization.properties, sehingga OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor akan menjawab 403 untuk staff. ManualFurnishServiceImpl menyimpan alamat dengan tipe 'registered_mail' yang tidak dipakai jalur furnish lain (furnished_mail). Bukan bukti story; dicatat agar tidak diklaim.
note_en: The comment names OCMS 41.41-41.51, but no caller exists in ocmsadminui/ocmseserviceui and the path /v1/furnish/officer/manual is absent from api-authorization.properties, so OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor would answer 403 for staff. ManualFurnishServiceImpl stores the address with type 'registered_mail', which no other furnish path uses (furnished_mail). Not evidence for a story; logged so it is not claimed.

feature: Auto-apply TS-HST saat furnish ID yang ada di tabel HST dan revive TS-HST bila offender lama HST diganti non-HST
type: Kode tanpa story di chunk ini
note: Setelah furnish/redirect, hstExists(idNo) memicu TS-HST otomatis; bila offender lama HST dan yang baru bukan, TS-HST di-revive (OCMS-DF-2026-093 dan OCMS-DF-2026-092, Closed). Tidak ada story di chunk ini yang menyebut HST pada furnish manual; dicatat sebagai kode ada tanpa story.
note_en: After furnish/redirect, hstExists(idNo) triggers an automatic TS-HST; if the old offender was HST and the new one is not, the TS-HST is revived (OCMS-DF-2026-093 and OCMS-DF-2026-092, Closed). No story in this chunk mentions HST on manual furnish; logged as code without a story.
